cohort: The study included all deliveries attended at Hospital de Manises from January 1, 2015 to December 31, 2016.
finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate was 16.08%, with Group 6 (nulliparous breeches) having the highest rate (97.6%) and Group 2 (nulliparous, single cephalic, >=37 weeks, induced or cesarean before labor) contributing the most (4.5%) to the total rate.
mod_finding: The Robson 10-Group Classification System is easily implemented and effective in identifying risk groups and clinical conditions that most impact cesarean delivery rates.
